scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,app -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @kemix/ui" "npm run dev -w @kemix/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,ui -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @kemix/server" "npm run dev -w @kemix/ui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kemix/ui && npm run build -w @kemix/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @kemix/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @kemix/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w @kemix/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/desktop
